Straight answers

Do you offer nightly or weekly stays?

No. Vaquero is a monthly, long-term community. Our leases are built for people who live here.

What rental types are available?

RV lots with 30-amp or 50-amp service, park-owned RVs, park-owned tiny homes, and a few rent-to-own homes.

How much is rent?

RV lots are $400 per month (30-amp) or $500 per month (50-amp). Park-owned RVs and tiny homes cost more and vary by unit. Each open lot lists its own rent and deposit.

Are pets allowed?

Yes, cats and small dogs are welcome. A fenced dog park is coming with our Phase 2 expansion.

How do I apply?

Send us the inquiry form or call or text us. We'll follow up about the lot you want. Approved residents pay rent and send maintenance requests through the resident portal.

Is there internet?

Yes. Free Wi-Fi covers the park, and 24-hour camera surveillance is active.
